producer_report.summary: Throughput figures in athena status now use time spent. Landing is measured from the last invocation's end to the landing record or the newest landing-phase host refusal recorded for the job, so it covers the CI wait and rebuild when recorded. Did-not-land and idle minutes sum invocation wall times and check durations, not first-call-to-close spans. Every figure prints a basis line. CHANGELOG has an entry. The review text in hestia.rs is updated to match.

criteria_check.criterion: A new test in crates/athena-core/src/status.rs builds fixture records for a landed job with a CI wait and a rebuild. Running `cargo test -p athena-core status` shows the landing stage reports their duration (it covers the wait and the rebuild, not just verifier end to outcome).
criteria_check.evidence: Test status::planning_cost_tests::the_landing_stage_covers_the_wait_and_rebuild_recorded_after_the_outcome (status.rs ~line 3119) passed in `cargo test -p athena-core status`.

criteria_check.criterion: A new test dispatches a job, runs it 20 minutes, and closes it days later. `cargo test -p athena-core status` shows it contributes 20 minutes to the 'did not land' figure, not the multi-day span.
A test shows idle time between jobs is computed from time spent, so a job left open for days does not hide the gap. Run `cargo test -p athena-core status`.

A test on `Throughput::text` output shows each figure in the section (landed per day, median per landed job and its stages, idle between jobs, did not land) states its basis, naming the records it was measured from. `athena status` prints that text, so the basis shows there.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing the corrected landing, unlanded and idle figures and the printed bases.
criteria_check.evidence: git diff shows 7 added lines in CHANGELOG.md.

criteria_check.criterion: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` all pass.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks; targeted status tests and the policy scan pass.

criteria_check.criterion: No path other than crates/athena-core/src/status.rs and CHANGELOG.md changes. No governance file (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) changes.
